sourceTitle: Johnston: 6. AMENDMENT TO THE JOHNSTON HOME RULE CHARTER SECTION 1-3 - CONDEMNATION Town of Johnston
exactQuestion: Shall Section 1-3 of the Johnston Town Charter be amended to identify a fund, establish a pledge of credit, and establish an enforcement mechanism for the exercise of its condemnation authority?
